notes.subject: פעל פעל
notes.rationale: noun + verb of the same root, 'a work he is working', repetition kept as baara / baara kɛ.

notes.subject: והתמהו תמהו
notes.rationale: doubled verb of astonishment, kept by repeating ka ɲɛgɛn.

notes.subject: פועל פועל
notes.rationale: KJV and JPS supply a subject 'I' (Yawe); Hebrew has no subject, rendered impersonally as baara dɔ bɛ baara kɛ.

notes.subject: to Israel
notes.rationale: plural imperatives summon the people to look among the nations and be astounded.

notes.subject: to Israel
notes.rationale: direct address with plural 'you' (aw) throughout the verse.

translation: Aw ye siyaw lajɛ, aw ye u ɲɛ kɔnɔ, ka ɲɛgɛn ka ɲɛgɛn; sabu baara dɔ bɛ baara kɛ aw tilew la, min lajɛra aw ma, aw tɛna a tiɲɛ.
